# io.systemd.AskPassword

An interface for interactively asking the user for a password

## Methods

### Ask

Interactively ask the user for a password, or answer from a previously cached entry

```go
func (c *Client) Ask(ctx context.Context, in AskIn) (*AskOut, error)
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `?string` | The message to show when prompting for the password |
| `keyname` | `?string` | The name for the kernel keyring entry used for caching |
| `icon` | `?string` | The icon name to display, following the freedesktop.org icon naming specification |
| `id` | `?string` | An recognizable id for the password prompt |
| `timeoutUSec` | `?int` | Timeout in µs (relative, CLOCK_MONOTONIC; set to zero to only check cache and not query interactively; set to UINT64_MAX to disable relative timeout; if not set defaults to 90s) |
| `untilUSec` | `?int` | Timeout in µs (absolute, CLOCK_MONOTONIC; if both timeoutUSec and untilUSec are specified the earlier of the two is used; set to zero to only check cache and not query interactively; leave unset or set to UINT64_MAX to disable absolute timeout) |
| `acceptCached` | `?bool` | Whether to accept cached passwords from the kernel keyring |
| `pushCache` | `?bool` | Whether to push acquired passwords into the kernel keyring |
| `echo` | `?EchoMode` | Whether to give visual feedback when typing in the password |
| `allowInteractiveAuthentication` | `?bool` | Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `passwords` | `[]string` | List of acquired passwords. This typically contains one entry, but might contain more in case multiple passwords were previously cached. |

## Types

### EchoMode

Encodes whether to provide visual feedback as the password is typed in

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `off` | Request that the password is prompted for without any visual feedback |
| `on` | Show the password in plaintext as it is typed in |
| `masked` | Provide visual feedback as the password is typed, but mask the password plaintext |

## Errors

| Error | Go type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NoPasswordAvailable` | `NoPasswordAvailableError` | No password available, because none was provided in the cache, and no agent was asked |
| `TimeoutReached` | `TimeoutReachedError` | Query timeout reached, user did not provide a password in time |
